ambiguous.name: Renal vein
ambiguous.reason: TA2 lists the renal vein only as sided terms (5000 vena renalis dextra, 5006 vena renalis sinistra); no unpaired term denotes this unsided record.

ambiguous.name: Cecum and appendix
ambiguous.reason: compound record (two organs in one record): TA2 terms exist separately — 2970 caecum, 2976 appendix vermiformis; no single TA2 term denotes the pair.

ambiguous.name: Biliary tree
ambiguous.reason: collective record: TA2 names the parts separately (3064 ductus biliferi interlobulares, 3091 ductus biliares extrahepatici, 3092 ductus hepaticus communis, 3101 ductus cysticus, 3103 ductus biliaris) and has no single term for the whole biliary tree.

ambiguous.name: Dentition
ambiguous.reason: TA2 repeats 'dentes' (teeth) under two ids — 901 (skeletal chapter) and 2818 (digestive chapter) — and carries no term 'dentition' for the dental set as such, which is what this record denotes.

ambiguous.name: Mammary gland and breast
ambiguous.reason: compound record ('mammary gland and breast'): TA2 terms 7097 mamma (breast) and 7099 glandula mammaria (mammary gland) each denote part of what this single record covers; neither denotes the whole.

ambiguous.name: Lymph nodes and lymphoid tissue
ambiguous.reason: the record covers lymph nodes AND lymphoid tissue generally; TA2 5191 nodi lymphoidei denotes the nodes only, and lymphoid tissue as such is TA2's chapter grouping (5149 organa lymphoidea), not a term denoting this record.

ambiguous.name: set of posterior cervical intertransversarii
ambiguous.reason: TA2 splits the posterior cervical intertransversarii into 2238 (laterales) and 2297 (mediales), with no single term for the posterior set as a whole.

ambiguous.name: Basal ganglia (basal nuclei)
ambiguous.reason: TA2 lists 'basal ganglia' only as a related term of 5559 corpus striatum, whose structure differs from this record (corpus striatum = caudate + lentiform nuclei; the record covers the basal nuclei group); no TA2 preferred or synonym term denotes the basal ganglia.

ambiguous.name: Pleurae and pleural cavities
ambiguous.reason: compound record ('pleurae and pleural cavities'): TA2 terms 3322 pleura and 3316 cavitas pleuralis denote its two parts separately.
